title: Managed AI Platforms
summary: Ship AI apps on cloud-managed platforms, open-weight hosts or routers, and decide which parts to outsource and which to keep.
outcome: Choose and defend a consumption path for any workload, operate a platform's identity, network, cost and capacity controls, and avoid lock-in.

project.title: Deploy on a Managed Platform
deliverables: Redeploy an earlier app on a managed platform, keeping behavior and changing the plumbing
Authenticate with cloud identity and least-privilege model access; no provider API key in the app
Route traffic over a private network path; record data location, retention and terms
Replace at least one hand-built component with a managed one and keep at least one hand-built, with a reason
Re-run the eval suite after the move and report quality, latency and cost changes
Route calls through a gateway with a working fallback, or justify direct single-provider calls
Size capacity, set a budget alert and state the volume where another pricing model wins
Write a one-page platform decision record with an exit plan

modules.title: The three ways to consume a model

topics.t: Three ways to consume a model
topics.d: Public API, managed platform in your cloud, or open weights hosted by you or a provider.
Platforms and inference providers serve open models on demand.

modules.tryIt: List every component of an app built on a public API that would change if it had to run inside a cloud account.
modules.outcome: Place any workload on the right consumption path and justify it.
modules.mentalModel: One application, three consumption paths: public API, managed platform in your cloud, or open weights you or a provider host.
